comment: claudebox managed settings, shared by both components of a pair (C8). Self-update is off by construction: currency comes from the daily box rebuild, never from the agent updating itself, because a self-installed binary would shadow the managed one and survive the rebuild. The deny list is a best-effort guardrail against casual package-discipline drift, not enforcement — the in-box user has sudo and prefix rules are reorderable. The real mechanism is the disposable box plus the daily rebuild: anything installed ad hoc dies within 24 hours. It encodes the bylaw's forbidden categories (COPR, language package managers onto PATH, self-bundling formats) so drift is at least noisy.
